verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled annual-report filing or recurring tax payment, is a fair question for an entity-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no automation capability. Filing is done through PDF forms submitted by upload, fax or mail, or through an online application open only during set hours. The franchise-tax entry page has an image CAPTCHA, and probes found no API or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
